articles.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
articles.summary: CoreWeave is facing a crisis of confidence on Wall Street that's playing out in real time among equity and bond investors. With interest rates spiking and AI buildout concerns mounting, debt-heavy neoclouds like CoreWeave are being viewed by many market participants as the most vulnerable trade in the artificial intelligence space.

articles.title: Southwest Airlines cuts 2026 profit forecast on higher fuel
articles.summary: Southwest Airlines became the third major U.S. airline this month to cut its 2026 profit forecast due to higher fuel prices, but CEO Bob Jordan said travelers continue to book despite higher fares. The carrier expects to earn between $2.60 and $2.85 a share on an adjusted basis this year, down from its forecast in July of between $3.25 to as much as $4.25 a share.

articles.title: BlackRock's Rick Rieder sees 'historic' opportunity in high-quality bonds
articles.summary: Investors may be wary of the volatility hitting parts of the bond market right now, but they have an "historic" opportunity to grab attractive yields in high-quality credit, Rick Rieder, BlackRock's chief investment officer for global fixed income, told CNBC in an exclusive interview.

articles.title: Apple's iPhone Duo in short supply — plus, the 2 stocks fueling an AI rebound
articles.summary: Wednesday's action marked a strong rebound in the AI infrastructure trade, with technology stocks and industrials tied to the data center buildout leading the market higher. CEO Elon Musk indicated on the SpaceX earnings call that power, cooling, and electrical equipment are the limiting factors in getting more gigawatts of compute online, which had investors feeling better about the outlooks for stocks like GE Vernova , Eaton , and Vertiv .

articles.title: Expanding AI trade is turning safety stocks into a 'Texas hedge'
articles.summary: Investors are bailing on higher-volatility growth stocks and running toward the shelter of perceived safety sectors like utilities and consumer staples. As valuation multiples across capital-intensive AI infrastructure plays — such as specialized data center hosting providers CoreWeave (CRWV) and Iren Ltd (IREN) — take on water in the form of massive debt loads due to aggressive capex buildouts, investors may want to take a portion of their equity exposure into more protected water.

articles.title: Meta and Tesla bulls get confidence boost after SpaceX earnings
articles.summary: Options trading in both stocks leaned bullish after the open Wednesday, with Meta options looking particularly one-sided as traders bought more calls than puts and more put trades likely initiated by sellers than buyers. Meta options have generally been bullish since the stock's March low, when the put/call ratio of open contracts plunged to 0.5, meaning two calls open for every one put contract, and that hasn't budged much since, Barchart data show.

articles.title: Tesla earnings loom after Musk calls SpaceX merger a 'good idea'
articles.summary: Musk pointed to the company's potential to cooperate on AI software, chip design, Terafab and robotics. Tesla is already using Grok AI technology, developed by SpaceX, to power AI assistants in customer cars, and to help control the company's Optimus humanoid robots now in development. Tesla CFO Vaibhav Taneja told investors on the company's last earnings call in July that automotive margins had been challenged this year by rising interest rates and energy costs.
